definitions.explanation: A small hole through which one can look, such as in a door to see who is outside, or in a fence or wall.

examples.japanese: ⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{覗|のぞ}き{穴|あな}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked outside through the peephole in the door.

examples.japanese: ⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{覗|のぞ}き{穴|あな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Apartment entrance doors come with a peephole.
I could see the neighbor's garden through a peephole in the fence.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{覗|のぞ}き→覗く：02388_nozoku⟧ (peeking) and ⟦{穴|あな}→穴：01691_ana⟧ (hole). Most commonly refers to the security peephole in apartment and house doors, which is a standard feature in Japanese housing. Can also refer to any small hole used for looking through.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{覗|のぞ}き{穴|あな}: door peephole
- {覗|のぞ}き{穴|あな}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look through a peephole
- {覗|のぞ}き{穴|あな}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check through a peephole

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{覗|のぞ}く→覗く：02388_nozoku⟧: to peek; to peep — the verb meaning to look through a small opening
- ドアスコープ: door scope — the loanword term for the same door peephole device
- ⟦{穴|あな}→穴：01691_ana⟧: hole — the generic term for any opening
